sources: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 233738 (public search API, 14 sites), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 13 overnight single-family sites on the recreation.gov catalog (the Forest Service page says 'Camp Sites: 12'), plus day-use-only group picnic site 14. Gravel spurs averaging 20 x 60 ft; 4 pull-through, 9 back-in. No maximum vehicle length is published.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/moose-creek-flat-campground ('Camp Sites: 12', 'TRAILER / RV SITES AVERAGE PARKING SPUR: 20' x 60'', 'the parking spurs are gravel') + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 233738 (13 STANDARD NONELECTRIC overnight + 1 GROUP PICNIC AREA day use; Driveway Entry 4 Pull-Through, Max Vehicle Length blank on all), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Hand-pump drinking water, trash collection and recycling, host on site. Accessible fishing dock at the river's edge.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233738 ('Vault toilets, drinking water and trash collection are provided'; amenities 'Drinking Water (hand pump)', 'Host', 'Recycling'; notices 'No RV Dump Station is located in any of the USFS campgrounds managed by ExplorUS in the Custer-Gallatin National Forest', 'There are NO Shower facilities available at this campground.') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/moose-creek-flat-campground ('An accessible fishing dock is located at the river's edge'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: '5/15 -9/30, Limited Service 10/1 - 12/1.' Off season there is no fee and no amenities.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/moose-creek-flat-campground (Seasons of Use '5/15 -9/30 Limited Service 10/1 - 12/1'; 'Off Season, there is no fee and no amenities available'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Peak season fee covers 2 vehicles; $9 each additional vehicle (interagency passes do not apply to it). Off season: no fee and no amenities.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233738/rates (2026 peak season STANDARD NONELECTRIC $26) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/moose-creek-flat-campground ('Off Season, there is no fee and no amenities available. Peak Season, there is a $26.00 fee which includes 2 driving vehicles. $9.00 each additional vehicle'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Concession-run: the Forest Service names Rocky Mountain Recreation Company, recreation.gov lists ExplorUS. All 13 overnight sites reservable on recreation.gov until 3 days before arrival.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233738 (catalog: all sites reservable; rules reservationCutOff 3; contact goexplorus.com) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/moose-creek-flat-campground ('Information: Rocky Mountain Recreation Company (661) 702-1420'), read 2026-10-22

note: USFS Custer Gallatin NF (Bozeman RD) campground in Gallatin Canyon, in an open meadow next to the Gallatin River near Moose Creek, ~32 mi S of Bozeman off US-191; paved campground roads. --Claude
summary: Confirmed reservable on recreation.gov, vault toilets and drinking water, no hookups, $26/night (2026 rate table). Changed count 14 -> 13 (the 14th is a day-use picnic site). Cleared derived max_rig_ft 60 (that is the average spur length; no rig length is published). Added 4 pull-throughs, no dump or showers, season 05-15 to 12-01 (limited service from 10/1), 3-day cutoff, concessionaire. Not stated: booking window (left inherited), stay limit, fcfs. Note trimmed.
flags: Missing phone: concessionaire Rocky Mountain Recreation Company, (661) 702-1420 (Forest Service page and recreation.gov).

Waterfront re-audit lead: the Forest Service says 'The campground sits next to the Gallatin River' with 'An accessible fishing dock ... at the river's edge'; recreation.gov lists 'River Access' and 'Beach Access'. The entry is 'not waterfront'.
